name: Franzele
beschreibung:
Nestled amid the towering peaks of the Oetztal Alps, Franzele in Soelden provides a welcoming home base for outdoor enthusiasts and holidaymakers alike. Guests appreciate comfortable rooms and personal attention.

World-class ski slopes, mountain cable cars, and scenic hiking paths are just a short trip away.
kurzbeschreibung: Franzele in Soelden offers cosy accommodation and heartfelt Tyrolean hospitality in the Oetztal valley.
